integrity: The proof reduces Birkhoff-orthogonal unit pairs to the two support types of a regular octagon and then checks every resulting one-variable branch exactly. The bundled symbolic verifier was replayed from the packaged file. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The computation is specific to the regular octagonal plane and does not classify T_perpendicular for all polygonal norms. Bibliographic and research-index searches cannot establish absolute novelty.
title: Exact T-perpendicular constant of the regular octagonal plane
